thread:
Avery (CEO): Quick follow-up from the all-hands Q&A — asked for concrete patterns on customer wins vs losses and top asks to feed into roadmap. I'll summarize then we can assign follow-ups.

Maya (Sales): Field summary: wins when we demo predictable latency and clear cost math. Losses when prospects worry about SSO/KMS, SOC2 evidence, or vendor lock-in. A bunch asked for dedicated capacity SLAs.

Priya (CS): Post-sale: wins when POC works end-to-end quickly and we hand over a basic ops checklist. Losses happen when handoffs lack runbooks and dashboards.

Leo (SE): Recurring technical asks: model-version pinning, deterministic evals, small config rollouts. SE snippets often unblock trials:
```yaml
model: redwood-4x
pin: v2.1
rollout: 10%
```

Jon (Eng): Engineering: main loss vector is long-tail latency during bursty traffic. We're adding request.trace_id and KV-cache miss metrics to help debug.

Maya (Sales): BYOK/KMS ETA? Several deals paused pending key custody details.

Avery (CEO): BYOK/KMS is on the Dedicated/Private roadmap; aiming for a Q3 beta. @Sam, please own a 1-pager for sales with KMS bullets and suggested contract language.

Sam (Product): Will draft and post in #product-resources by EOD tomorrow. I'll include SOC2 artifact checklist and a short FAQ.

Priya (CS): Can docs include a one-page ops checklist and sample alert thresholds? That reduces churn.

Leo (SE): I'll attach a 6-step POC checklist and runnable examples to the SE kit.

Jon (Eng): For oncall: paste request.trace_id in #eng-oncall and we'll pull traces.

Avery (CEO): Leadership asks: fund a short docs/SE collateral sprint and prioritize publishing SOC2 artifacts + a public FAQ for sales. I'll take to finance.

All-Hands Bot: Notes + action items -> https://notion.redwood/workspace/all-hands-1774501234

Maya (Sales): :thumbsup: This should speed deals.

Sam (Product): I'll also pull a Q1 lost-deals-by-reason report with @Maya and share by Friday.

Avery (CEO): Thanks — drop customer quotes on the Notion page. Closing thread.
